title: Subobjects form a set in an abelian category with a generator
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with a generator $U$ (generator as in [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]). For every object $X$ of $\mathcal A$, the subobjects of $X$ form a set.
